visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female hand is seen opening a commercial-grade microwave oven inside a brightly lit 7-Eleven convenience store. She points specifically to a red 'Scanning Area' sticker inside the door frame. (2) Close-up shot of the microwave's digital control panel as it displays 'SCAN' and then automatically updates the heating time based on the meal placed near it. (3) A young man with black-rimmed glasses and a grey sleeveless athletic shirt is seen holding his smartphone, reacting with surprise to the footage. (4) The man is then shown at a 7-Eleven, holding a boxed meal. He opens a similar microwave and moves the meal toward the red scanning indicator. (5) The digital display of the microwave automatically populates with '50' seconds. He closes the door and presses the start button. (6) The video concludes with the microwave in operation, showing the timer counting down while the man watches.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice explains how to use the microwave. Background music features a rhythmic, bubbly Japanese meme song. A clear mechanical click is heard as the microwave door opens. (2) The female voice continues, emphasizing the location of the scanning area. The BGM remains consistent with a steady synth beat. (3) A sharp 'beep' sound signals the microwave has successfully scanned the item. Rustling of plastic packaging is heard as the meal is moved. (4) A male voice enters with a slightly lower pitch, expressing skepticism with 'Huh? Is it real?'. (5) A series of mechanical thuds and clicks occur as the man places his own meal in a different microwave. The BGM tempo stays bright and energetic. (6) A final electronic beep confirms the automatic timer setting. The male voice exclaims with joy and surprise. The audio track maintains high clarity throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to demonstrate a convenient new feature in 7-Eleven microwaves that allows users to scan their pre-packaged meals for automatic heating time settings, effectively removing the need for manual button presses.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While 7-Eleven branding is prominent, the video is structured as a personal discovery/verification vlog rather than a formal advertisement.
